title: Junior Machine Learning Engineer
description: Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here: At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well-being, and nurture your career. Over our 80-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI-enabled insights and technology-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry. Job Description: Job Overview The Junior Machine Learning Engineer works within an Applied AI and Machine Learning delivery team to develop, test, deploy, and support AI and machine learning solutions. This early-career role is designed for candidates with strong programming and analytical foundations who want to build scalable, production-ready AI products under the guidance of senior engineers, data scientists, and technical leads. Key Responsibilities Assist in collecting, cleaning, transforming, profiling, and validating structured and unstructured data. Perform exploratory data analysis to identify patterns, anomalies, trends, data quality issues, and potential features. Develop and evaluate baseline machine learning models under guidance using appropriate algorithms and metrics. Support use cases involving classification, regression, clustering, anomaly detection, forecasting, natural language processing, and Generative AI. Write reusable, readable, secure, and testable Python code aligned with team coding standards. Help convert notebooks and experiments into modular code, repeatable pipelines, APIs, or scheduled workloads. Assist with feature engineering, model comparison, hyperparameter tuning, error analysis, and experiment tracking. Support deployment of models through APIs, containers, batch jobs, or approved cloud services. Help monitor model quality, data drift, model drift, latency, failures, and operational performance. Participate in code reviews, pair programming, Agile ceremonies, technical discussions, and knowledge-sharing sessions. Document datasets, experiments, assumptions, model results, dependencies, limitations, and implementation decisions. Identify and escalate data privacy, security, compliance, responsible AI, and model-performance risks. Essential Job Functions Data Preparation and Exploration Perform data cleaning, feature preparation, validation, and exploratory analysis. Use Python libraries such as Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, and Scikit-learn. Document data quality findings and support corrective actions. Model Development Build baseline machine learning models and compare performance using suitable evaluation metrics. Support feature engineering, error analysis, and hyperparameter tuning. Assist with consumption of foundation models and Large Language Models. Machine Learning Engineering Use Git for source control and collaboration. Package basic applications or models using Docker. Support APIs, pipelines, experiment tracking, and introductory MLOps practices. Testing and Monitoring Write unit tests and data validation checks. Assist in testing model behavior and production performance. Support logging, monitoring, troubleshooting, and incident documentation. Required Qualifications and Skills Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related area. 0 to 2 years of relevant experience, including internships, academic projects, research, hackathons, or personal projects. Working knowledge of Python and SQL. Understanding of statistics, probability, linear algebra, supervised learning, and unsupervised learning. Ability to communicate technical findings clearly and work effectively in a collaborative Agile environment. Strong analytical, problem-solving, documentation, and continuous-learning abilities. Preferred Skills Exposure to Azure Machine Learning, Azure AI services, or Azure AI Foundry. Familiarity with PyTorch, TensorFlow, or similar frameworks. Exposure to Large Language Models, prompt engineering, embeddings, vector databases, or retrieval-augmented generation. Familiarity with Claude Code, Codex, or similar agents, used to speed up your own development and to deliver AI-native solutions, with the judgment to review and own what they produce. Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, REST APIs, Linux, GitHub, and MLflow or similar experiment tracking. Awareness of responsible AI, privacy, explainability, and AI governance. Mandatory Pre-Joining Technology Training Selected candidates must complete the assigned role-specific learning plan, hands-on exercises, knowledge checks, and readiness assessment before joining or deployment. Python programming and object-oriented programming NumPy, Pandas, data visualization, and SQL Statistics and probability for machine learning Supervised and unsupervised machine learning Model evaluation, feature engineering, and error analysis Introduction to deep learning and natural language processing Generative AI, Large Language Models, prompt engineering, embeddings, vector databases, and RAG Azure Machine Learning, Azure AI services, and Azure AI Foundry Git, GitHub, Linux, Docker, REST APIs, and testing fundamentals MLOps, experiment tracking, model monitoring, responsible AI, Agile, and Azure DevOps Pre-Joining Capstone Build and demonstrate an end-to-end machine learning solution covering data preparation, model development, evaluation, packaging, documentation, and basic deployment or inference. We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times. Our Benefits: At Crowe, we know that great people are what makes a great firm. We value our people and offer employees a comprehensive benefits package. Learn more about what working at Crowe can mean for you! How You Can Grow: We will nurture your talent in an inclusive culture that values diversity. You will have the chance to meet on a consistent basis with your Career Coach that will guide you in your career goals and aspirations. Learn more about where talent can prosper! More about Crowe: Crowe Capability Center – India, operating under the legal entity C3 India Delivery Centre LLP (formerly known as Crowe Horwath IT Services LLP) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Crowe LLP (U.S.A.), a public accounting, consulting and technology firm with offices around the world. Crowe LLP is an independent member firm of Crowe Global, one of the largest global accounting networks in the world. The network consists of more than 200 independent accounting and advisory firms in more than 130 countries around the world. Crowe does not accept unsolicited candidates, referrals or resumes from any staffing agency, recruiting service, sourcing entity or any other third-party paid service at any time. Any referrals, resumes or candidates submitted to Crowe, or any employee or owner of Crowe without a pre-existing agreement signed by both parties covering the submission will be considered the property of Crowe, and free of charge. We are committed to a merit-based hiring process, evaluating all candidates consistently using objective, job-related criteria such as relevant experience, demonstrated skills, measurable impact, and alignment with the role’s responsibilities, and making employment decisions in a fair and inclusive manner free from discrimination.

title: IT Head
description: Role Overview We are seeking a seasoned, strategic Head of IT to lead the technology architecture, digital transformation, and operational resilience across our diverse business verticals: Media Production Studios, Commercial Malls, and Multiplex/Theater Operations . The ideal candidate possesses a unique blend of enterprise IT infrastructure management, high-performance media/post-production workflow expertise, and smart-building/retail IT operations (POS, building management integration, high-density public Wi-Fi, and digital cinema/exhibition technologies). You will drive operational excellence, enforce robust cybersecurity frameworks, and align technology investments with organizational growth. Key Responsibilities 1. Enterprise & Smart Infrastructure Management (Malls & Corporate) · Oversee the end-to-end enterprise IT infrastructure, including data centers, server farms, enterprise storage, virtualization (VMware/Hyper-V), and hybrid cloud environments (AWS/Azure). · Manage mission-critical IT systems for commercial mall operations, ensuring high availability of Building Management Systems (BMS), Public Address (PA) systems, CCTV/surveillance networks, and automated access controls. · Architect and maintain high-density public Wi-Fi networks, structured cabling, and robust switching/routing backbones (L2/L3) across retail and office spaces. · Oversee disaster recovery (DR) planning, business continuity drills, and power redundancy systems (UPS/Generators) for 24/7 retail and entertainment environments. 2. Multiplex, Cinema & Digital Exhibition Technology · Oversee IT and networking infrastructure supporting digital cinema projection systems, server ingestion, and Theatre Management Systems (TMS). · Manage automated scheduling, digital signage, box office ticketing kiosks, and secure content delivery (KDM/DCP management) in coordination with content distributors. · Ensure ultra-low latency and absolute uptime for live-streaming, event screenings, and concessionaire point-of-sale (POS) networks. 3. Post-Production & Media Studio Technology · Support high-performance media workflows including non-linear editing (Avid, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve), VFX, animation, sound design, and heavy rendering farms. · Administer high-speed SAN/NAS environments optimized for uncompressed 4K/8K real-time collaboration. · Manage Media Asset Management (MAM) systems, secure ingest/transcoding pipelines, and long-term digital archiving/retrieval processes. 4. Retail & Point-of-Sale (POS) Operations · Ensure 99.99% uptime for mission-critical retail POS terminals, payment gateway integrations, inventory management databases, and merchant Wi-Fi networks within mall premises. · Coordinate with tenant IT teams and retail partners to ensure seamless network integration and compliance with centre guidelines. 5. Cybersecurity, Compliance & Data Privacy · Establish enterprise-wide cybersecurity policies, endpoint protection, Next-Gen Firewalls (NGFW), and SIEM tools. · Protect high-value intellectual property (IP), unreleased media assets, and confidential tenant/customer data in compliance with data privacy regulations (e.g., DPDP Act, PCI-DSS for retail transactions). · Conduct regular vulnerability assessments, penetration testing, and IT security audits. 6. Vendor, Project & Budget Management · Lead strategic technology implementation projects, digital upgrades, and capital expenditure (CapEx/OpEx) planning. · Manage relationships with global technology vendors, telecom operators, OEM partners, and service providers. · Negotiate Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMCs), software licensing, and hardware procurement to optimize costs without compromising quality. 7. Leadership & Cross-Functional Team Management · Lead, mentor, and upskill a multi-disciplinary team of IT engineers, system administrators, and helpdesk support staff. · Define and monitor strict Service Level Agreements (SLAs) for incident resolution and system performance. · Act as a technology advisor to executive leadership, bridging the gap between creative teams, retail management, and technical execution. Core Enterprise & Network Infrastructure · Advanced administration of Windows Server, Linux, and macOS enterprise environments. · Enterprise networking: Cisco/Aruba L2/L3 switching, VLAN segmentation, SD-WAN, enterprise firewalls, and QoS configuration. · Virtualization & Cloud: VMware ESXi, Hyper-V, AWS, Azure, and hybrid cloud integration. · Active Directory, LDAP, SSO, and Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) frameworks. · Advanced backup frameworks (Veeam, Commvault) and Disaster Recovery architecture. Domain-Specific Expertise · Retail & Mall Tech: POS infrastructure, payment gateway security (PCI-DSS), digital signage networks, and smart building integration (BMS/CCTV). · Theater/Exhibition Tech: Theatre Management Systems (TMS), digital projection networks, and ticketing system integration. · Media / Post-Production: High-speed SAN/NAS (Avid ISIS/Nexus, Isilon, QNAP), render management (Deadline, OpenCue), and MAM workflows. Educational Qualifications & Credentials · Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Electronics, or a related technical field. Master’s degree / MBA is a plus. Pay: ₹2,000,000.00 - ₹25,000,000.00 per year Benefits: Flexible schedule Paid sick time Paid time off Provident Fund Work Location: In person
